We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 People Operations Manager (m/f/d) Your Role

You own everything after a candidate signs, from contracts through offboarding, and automate as much of it as possible. We are looking for someone to build the structural backbone to enable rapid scaling.

 * Contracts & onboarding: Manage employment contracts for all employees (direct and indirect employment), organize equipment, accounts, workspaces, and support relocation of international colleagues.

 * HR tooling & automation: introduce and own an HRIS tool, automate workflows across systems.

 * Payroll: Organize and own internal payroll processes, including variable compensation calculation of all sales teams.

 * Compliance & people legal: Support international hiring (EU and non-EU), time-tracking, collective agreements, international taxation topics, etc.

 * Compensation: Manage and monitor compensation bands across teams/countries.

 * Events & culture: Organize internal and external events (hackathons, off-sites, etc.)

 * Offboarding: Manage offboarding of employees.

 * Later, people development: Design feedback cycles, L&D, career development (e.g. SDR academy).

What to Expect

 * Solo, end-to-end ownership of everything people operations.

 * Hands-on operational work to build the foundation for automation/scaling.

 * Direct impact: your work has immediate influence on the culture of fonio.

 * Flat hierarchies: close collaboration across departments.

What You Bring

 * 3+ year of People Ops, HR, or Operations experience, ideally startup or scale-up.

 * Knowledge about Austrian labor law, payroll, and collective agreements

 * Structured, hands-on working style.

 * AI and automation/workflow skills.

 * People-first, low ego. You thrive under intensity.

 * German native, strong English.

What We Offer

 * €65,000 to €80,000

 * Equity

 * Relocation support

 * Daily lunch and dinner

 * Equipment of your choice

 * Regular team off-sites

 * On-site in Vienna, working directly with the core-team

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 20 min culture fit with the founders

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 SEO Manager (m/f/d) Your Role

You are fonio's in-house SEO lead. Your job: make us rank #1 on Google and in AI search tools (ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc.) for every relevant query, not just in DACH but internationally. You own strategy and execution, guide the website team on how pages should be structured, and set the direction for keyword research across all markets. We'll work with agencies here and there, but the expertise lives with you.

What to expect

 * Own SEO strategy and execution across all our markets, starting with DACH and expanding internationally

 * Define how pages are built and structured, working closely with the website and engineering teams on technical SEO

 * Lead keyword research and decide how we go after both traditional search and AI-generated results

 * Commission or write the content needed to rank

 * Manage a €20.000-€30.000/month SEO budget

 * Work with external agencies where it makes sense, but hold the strategy yourself

Who We're Looking For

Must-have:

 * You've built SEO at real scale before, full-time. Not "co-owned SEO alongside other things" but SEO as your main job, with results to show for it. Industry (tech, consumer, anything) matters less than the scale you've operated at.

 * International SEO experience, you know how to approach markets beyond your home market

 * Fluent in English and German

Nice-to-have:

 * Strong copywriting skills (an SEO person who can write well is rare and valuable)

 * Hands-on with website tools like Webflow or similar

What We Offer

 * Competitive salary: €65.000-€100.000

 * Equity - you build it, you should own a piece of it.

 * Food & drinks - at our Vienna office, lunch and dinner are on us (plus all the drinks your heart desires, and yes, we have protein bars and vitamins too).

 * Relocation bonus (if you still need to move to Vienna)

 * Equipment of your choice - whatever makes you happy.

 * Regular team offsites.

 * 30 min skill interview

1 Regulatory Credit Risk specialist (f/m/x) 

Group IRB Coordination is part of Group Risk Controlling and is primarily responsible for coordinating RBI Group's credit risk related activities under the Internal Ratings-Based (IRB) approach. The department serves as a central interface for IRB-related communication with European and national banking supervisors and supports the consistent implementation of regulatory requirements across RBI Group.

In this role, you will contribute to supervisory processes, regulatory monitoring, reporting, and the coordination of internal credit risk model topics. You will work with colleagues across Risk, IT, Legal and RBI's network units while building practical knowledge of internal models and European banking regulation.

 

Your role at RBI:
 

 * Support IRB related regulatory applications, supervisory requests, on-site inspections and the monitoring of related follow-up measures
 * Become expert of internal credit risk model processes and related regulatory requirements 
 * Support cooperation with Raiffeisen Sector Austria for internal credit risk models
 * Act as a coordination point and develop reliable working relationships with colleagues from credit risk management, IT, Legal, Group subsidiaries and other stakeholders across all hierarchy levels.
 * Monitor relevant European regulatory developments and translate updates into concise information for internal stakeholders
 * Operate data-quality and reporting processes and identify opportunities to simplify or automate recurring activities
 * Support the testing and responsible use of data, automation and AI-based tools for process improvement

 

Your core competencies:
 

 * Education and/or practical experience in at least one relevant area, such as credit risk, risk controlling, internal models, banking regulation, audit or financial-services legal work
 * Ability to understand regulatory requirements and apply them to processes, documentation or reporting
 * Experience coordinating information and deliverables across several stakeholders or organizational units
 * Ability to explain technical or regulatory topics clearly to specialist and non-specialist audiences
 * Experience working with structured data, reports or data-quality checks
 * Professional English skills for written documentation, meetings and communication with international stakeholders
 * Ability to communicate clearly and influence stakeholders effectively

 

Nice-to-have:
 

 * Knowledge of the Internal Ratings-Based approach, Basel framework, CRR or EBA guidelines
 * Experience with supervisory requests, regulatory examinations or communication with banking authorities
 * Experience using SQL, Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot, Claude or comparable automation and AI tools
 * German skills for collaboration with Austrian stakeholders

 

What's in it for you:
 

 * Global community: 75+ nationalities, English as the company language, and work permit support. 
 * Career growth: We believe in continuous learning and proactive career development. Take on challenging work that stretches your abilities, attend trainings, and use new technologies to make a lasting impact.
 * Flexible work week: Flexible hours and work-from-home options from Austria
 * Stay healthy: Subsidized canteen, well-being programs, check-ups, and sport allowances.
 * Save money: Discounts, exclusive banking terms, and a heavily subsidized public transport pass.
 * Family support: Child allowances, gender-neutral parental leave, bilingual company kindergarten, and holiday childcare.
 * Competitive salary: In accordance with Austrian legal requirements, the minimum salary for this position is EUR 2.981,98 gross per month under the applicable Banking Collective Agreement. The actual salary is typically higher and will be determined individually based on your qualifications, professional experience, and the specific requirements of the role. We are happy to discuss the details in person.
